notes_for_editor: Single source (FFLOS detail page); the register gives no built date, design, staffing, or access, so the story leaves those out. Record us-al-murrell-hill-2 (OSM 'Murrell Hill Lookout Tower', 32.213207, -85.078821, 155 m, status unknown) is about 20 km from this record's FFLOS point (32.3454, -85.245) and may be a different structure or a misplaced point. It is not cited or merged here; a human should decide. The FFLOS coordinates and elevation match the record. Not checked: the Alabama Forestry Commission list the register cites.
